SCE.S:365EC0: How may I help you? For Indenco Net, please see Public Relations on the 10th floor.
SCE.S:365F78: Indenco Net Service reports on the town's situation using reliable information.
SCE.S:366034: You use Indenco Net Service? Thank you very much. We strive to provide community-based information.
SCE.S:3696C0: From the newspaper? Do you have an appointment? ......... The owner is expecting you. Take the elevator in the back to the executive office on the 20th floor.
SCE.S:3697B0: Indenco Net Service reports on the town's situation using reliable information. The source, you ask? ...For details, please ask Public Relations.
SCE.S:3698B4: Let me explain the numbers in the "town status" shown on Indenco Net Service. {8}0{2} is a building not yet invaded. {8}1{2} is a building under invasion. When a building is cleared it becomes {8}2{2}, when the whole town is at peace, {8}3{2}, and when you change, {8}4{2}. How do we know that? Actually, we don't know either. Our computer displays it automatically.
SCE.S:369A74: (Pleased to meet you. The three of us run {7}Indenco{2}. This form is not our real body. We aren't three separate personalities, either. We took this form so Earthlings would find us familiar and easy to understand.)
SCE.S:369BB0: (For over 4,000 years we have watched over Earth's evolution, hoping that someday you might join us. We respect Earthlings' spontaneous evolution and have tried to avoid direct intervention in your civilization. But this time, something special has happened: the intrusion of "them." "They" are trying to bring unnatural evolution to Earth for their own benefit.)
SCE.S:369D6C: (A few days ago, a spaceship capable of traveling between galaxies landed in the mountains north of town. The ship belonged to a civilization that fell victim to "them." That civilization no longer exists. Aboard the ship was someone unnaturally changed by "them." Using this changed one as a medium, "they" invaded this town.)
SCE.S:36A118: (You have seen the many changed ones in the {7}mine{2}. That is the result of the unnatural, hasty evolution "they" brought to this town. Such changes distort the world. They must be stopped. You Earthlings must stop the change with your own hands.)
SCE.S:36A290: (The changes of form happening in this town are contagious. The source of the contagion is "them." "They" will spread across the whole Earth and consume everything. Change is their food.)
SCE.S:36A38C: ("They," who bring the change, are neither intelligent beings with personalities nor material beings. Your culture has no concept that describes "them" accurately. If we had to say, the concept of "devil" may be relatively close.)
SCE.S:36D6C0: From the newspaper? Do you have an appointment? ......... The owner is expecting you. Take the elevator in the back to the executive office on the 20th floor.
SCE.S:36D7B0: ...Actually, I've never even seen the owner.
SCE.S:36D84C: Have you met the owner? Not a single person on this floor has seen the owner!
SCE.S:36D908: ("They" are trying to leave for another dimension through the "path of power" in the mine. The more who leave, the thicker and sturdier the path becomes.)
SCE.S:36DA04: (When the "path of power" is complete, the power needed for change will be brought from another dimension. Once enough power flows in, the conscious beings on Earth will change in an instant. The change "they" bring creates distortion within each individual consciousness.)
SCE.S:36DB50: ("They" call the path that brings the "power" of change the Catapult of Consciousness. It is on the second underground level of the mine. Go there.)
